Alongside these reductions, PayPal has emphasized reinvesting a significant portion of those savings into its evolution from a payments provider into a broader money management and commerce platform, with Venmo playing an important role. items.title: What Are You Actually Buying In PayPal Stock?
items.summary: PayPal (PYPL) trades at 9.8 times earnings while the S&P 500 trades at 23.2. The profitability underneath is ordinary: an 18.4% operating margin against 18.5% for the market. The discount is not about whether the company makes money. It is about what each dollar it moves is worth.
